title: W014 Mandal Temporal Version Model Preflight (Definer Least-Privilege Verification & M13 Public Principal Testing Correction)
authority: Independent CTO / Co-founder Directive W014 Final Security Review Correction Round

concept_1_temporal_currentness.definition: Temporal bookkeeping within a specific dataset lineage. Indicates whether a version represents the latest open-ended validity state (valid_to IS NULL) for an entity within that dataset.
concept_1_temporal_currentness.isolation_rule: An UNVERIFIED candidate dataset may have one is_current=true version for internal continuity without conferring legal authority.

concept_2_data_governance.definition: W012 dataset-level institutional authority ('OFFICIAL' vs 'UNVERIFIED' vs 'CANDIDATE' vs 'REPLACED') anchored in verified cryptographic Gazette records.
concept_2_data_governance.authority_rule: OFFICIAL status is granted exclusively through the W012 evidence verification workflow. Temporal currentness does NOT confer OFFICIAL status.

concept_3_canonical_pointer.definition: The stable entity's canonical legal pointer. Must satisfy BOTH temporal currentness (is_current = true) AND W012 institutional authority (default_status = 'OFFICIAL').
concept_3_canonical_pointer.enforcement: Enforced at database level by composite FK, deferred constraint trigger Layer 2, and transition function security checks.

independence_axioms: is_current = true != OFFICIAL (A candidate version can be temporally current without being legally official)
OFFICIAL dataset eligibility != temporal currentness (A historical version can belong to an OFFICIAL dataset without being temporally current)

w012_ownership: Source and evidence acquisition and verification
Statutory Gazette order validation and evidence_records creation
Promotion of dataset_versions to OFFICIAL status
w014_ownership: Same-anchor identity enforcement via composite FK
Non-overlapping date intervals via GiST exclusion
Temporal currentness invariant (is_current = true <=> valid_to IS NULL)
Canonical pointer eligibility check against W012's OFFICIAL status
w012_w014_contract_boundary.contract_inheritance_rule: W014 MUST NOT duplicate the W012 legal-evidence promotion workflow. W014 trusts the W012 contract: dataset_versions.default_status = 'OFFICIAL' certifies that W012 has already completed its required statutory promotion workflow. W014 never itself promotes UNVERIFIED/CANDIDATE data to OFFICIAL.

existing_columns: state_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES states(code)
mandals_table.existing_validity_dates: NONE (No valid_from, valid_to, is_current, or current_version_id columns currently exist on public.mandals)

bidirectional_current_version_integrity.formal_statement: mandals.current_version_id -> mandal_versions.is_current = true (Unidirectional implication; candidate datasets may have their own current version)

layer_1_composite_fk.mandals_fk: FOREIGN KEY (current_version_id, id) REFERENCES public.mandal_versions(id, mandal_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
layer_1_composite_fk.guarantee: Declaratively guarantees same-anchor identity. mandals.current_version_id cannot resolve to a version belonging to any other mandal_id. Cross-mandal assignment fails with 23503. Deletion of referenced version is RESTRICTed.

layer_2_anchor_constraint_trigger.type: CONSTRAINT TRIGGER ... AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF current_version_id DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
layer_2_anchor_constraint_trigger.guarantee: Asserts at commit time that mandals.current_version_id resolves to a mandal_versions row with is_current = true AND its dataset_versions has default_status = 'OFFICIAL'. Fails closed with ERR-W014-001 (23514) on inactive version, or ERR-W014-003 (23514) on non-OFFICIAL dataset.

layer_3_version_constraint_trigger.type: CONSTRAINT TRIGGER ... AFTER UPDATE OF is_current OR DELETE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
layer_3_version_constraint_trigger.guarantee: Asserts at commit time that if a mandal_version transitions from is_current = true to false or is deleted, NO row in public.mandals has current_version_id pointing to it. Direct deactivation while referenced fails closed with ERR-W014-002 (23514).

layer_4_single_current_partial_index.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_mandal_versions_single_current ON public.mandal_versions (mandal_id) WHERE is_current = true;
layer_4_single_current_partial_index.guarantee: Strictly guarantees that at most one version per mandal_id can have is_current = true simultaneously within the table. Setting a second version to is_current = true violates 23505.

layer_5_temporal_currentness_check.definition: CHECK ((is_current = false) OR (is_current = true AND valid_to IS NULL))
layer_5_temporal_currentness_check.guarantee: Guarantees that an active version can never have a non-null valid_to date. Attempting to activate a closed version or close an active version directly fails with 23514.

role_distinction.function_owner: panin_boundary_definer (non-login dedicated role owning boundary objects; cannot connect or execute independently)
role_distinction.database_administrator: postgres / supabase_admin (cluster infrastructure and DDL migrations; not an application caller)
role_distinction.trusted_application_execution_role: service_role (backend worker / internal API service role)
role_distinction.boundary_admin_role: panin_boundary_admin (human administrative role for boundary management)
role_distinction.unprivileged_roles: PUBLIC, anon, authenticated (zero execution privileges; rejected at database engine level)

exact_minimum_grants: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO panin_boundary_definer;
GRANT SELECT ON TABLE public.dataset_versions TO panin_boundary_definer;
GRANT SELECT ON TABLE public.provenance_records TO panin_boundary_definer;
GRANT SELECT, UPDATE (current_version_id, updated_at) ON TABLE public.mandals TO panin_boundary_definer;
GRANT SELECT, UPDATE (is_current, valid_from, valid_to, updated_at) ON TABLE public.mandal_versions TO panin_boundary_definer;
prohibited_privileges: TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, TRIGGER grants on any table
Any privilege on unrelated application or auth tables

explicit_least_privilege_verification.no_unintended_privileges_check: Inspect has_table_privilege('panin_boundary_definer', tbl, priv) for INSERT, DELETE, TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, TRIGGER across dataset_versions, provenance_records, mandals, mandal_versions; assert all evaluate to false.
explicit_least_privilege_verification.no_inherited_memberships_check: Query pg_auth_members where member = 'panin_boundary_definer'::regrole; assert count = 0 (no role inheritance / privilege escalation).
explicit_least_privilege_verification.table_ownership_check: Query pg_class where relname IN ('mandals', 'mandal_versions', 'dataset_versions', 'provenance_records'); assert relowner::regrole != 'panin_boundary_definer'::regrole (is_table_owner = false).
explicit_least_privilege_verification.no_unrelated_schema_usage_check: Query information_schema.schema_privileges; assert usage granted ONLY on schema public, zero CREATE on any schema.

security_execution_model.object_qualification: All table and function references explicitly qualified as public.<object>

revocations: REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.fn_transition_mandal_current_version(TEXT, UUID, DATE, TEXT, UUID) FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.fn_transition_mandal_current_version(TEXT, UUID, DATE, TEXT, UUID) FROM anon;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.fn_transition_mandal_current_version(TEXT, UUID, DATE, TEXT, UUID) FROM authenticated;
grants: GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.fn_transition_mandal_current_version(TEXT, UUID, DATE, TEXT, UUID) TO service_role;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.fn_transition_mandal_current_version(TEXT, UUID, DATE, TEXT, UUID) TO panin_boundary_admin;

security_execution_model.caller_authorization_mechanism: Caller authorization is governed strictly by PostgreSQL EXECUTE privileges (ACLs). PUBLIC is an ACL principal inspected via pg_proc/proacl/aclexplode (not a session role; cannot be executed as a login role). Unprivileged session roles (anon, authenticated) are rejected by PostgreSQL engine with 42501 before entering the function body. The function body contains ZERO authorization dependence on CURRENT_USER or SESSION_USER.

p_operator_and_session_audit_semantics.p_operator_role: AUDIT METADATA ONLY. Zero authorization authority. Authorization is determined strictly by PostgreSQL EXECUTE privileges.
p_operator_and_session_audit_semantics.session_user_role: Recorded in JSONB receipt strictly as audit metadata (originating database connection identity).

table_dml_privilege_model.designated_canonical_path: public.fn_transition_mandal_current_version() is the designated canonical application transition path for all application services and administrative workflows.
table_dml_privilege_model.public_anon_authenticated: SELECT only via RLS. INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE are strictly denied.
table_dml_privilege_model.panin_boundary_admin: Granted EXECUTE on transition function. Base-table DML is restricted, mandating execution through the designated function.
table_dml_privilege_model.service_role_classification: Trusted infrastructure / backend execution exception. Retains direct table DML under the standard Supabase operational architecture for migration runs and disaster recovery, outside the physical application-path guarantee. Direct DML remains physically constrained by Layers 1-5 database engine integrity rules.
table_dml_privilege_model.defense_in_depth: Any direct DML by service_role or administrators remains physically constrained by Layers 1-5 integrity constraints (composite FK, deferred triggers, partial unique index, check constraint). Invalid direct mutations fail closed.

provenance_semantics.narrow_scope: If p_provenance_id is supplied, it must resolve to an existing public.provenance_records row (FK existence check; 23503). This check alone does NOT prove statutory authority; W012 remains exclusively responsible for evidence/provenance promotion.

elimination_of_dead_governance_state.v_dataset_status: Directly evaluated: IF v_dataset_status <> 'OFFICIAL' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ERR-W014-003 (23514). Dead governance variables completely removed.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Direct invalid mutations fail-closed with explicit error
acceptance_matrix.enforcement_mechanism: Triggers raise explicit ERR-W014-001, ERR-W014-002, ERR-W014-003 exceptions with SQLSTATE 23514.
acceptance_matrix.test_design: Execute uncoordinated direct SQL mutations violating mutual invariants.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Version transition via designated canonical application path succeeds atomically
acceptance_matrix.enforcement_mechanism: Stored function public.fn_transition_mandal_current_version() with row-level lock and atomic transaction block.
acceptance_matrix.test_design: Call fn_transition_mandal_current_version() from authorized role with valid parameters.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: UNVERIFIED candidate versions cannot be promoted to current legal truth without W012 evidence
acceptance_matrix.enforcement_mechanism: Compound check (mv.is_current = true AND dv.default_status = 'OFFICIAL'); initial migration prohibits seeding unevidenced mandals as OFFICIAL.
acceptance_matrix.test_design: Query canonical public view v_current_mandals to confirm candidate versions are excluded; audit initial seed data.
acceptance_matrix.expected_sqlstate_or_error: ZERO candidate rows returned in official views

acceptance_matrix.requirement: current_version_id cannot reference a version whose dataset status is non-authoritative
acceptance_matrix.enforcement_mechanism: Database trigger trg_guard_mandal_current_version joining dataset_versions and asserting dv.default_status = 'OFFICIAL'.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: is_current=true with valid_to IS NOT NULL is rejected
acceptance_matrix.enforcement_mechanism: Table check constraint chk_mandal_versions_current_invariants CHECK ((is_current = false) OR (is_current = true AND valid_to IS NULL)).
acceptance_matrix.test_design: UPDATE public.mandal_versions SET is_current = true WHERE valid_to IS NOT NULL;

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Directly closing a current version is rejected
acceptance_matrix.enforcement_mechanism: Table check constraint chk_mandal_versions_current_invariants (rejects valid_to on active) + Layer 3 trigger (rejects deactivation while referenced).
acceptance_matrix.test_design: UPDATE public.mandal_versions SET valid_to = '2026-01-01' WHERE is_current = true;

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Transition to an authoritative open-ended version succeeds atomically
acceptance_matrix.enforcement_mechanism: fn_transition_mandal_current_version() with OFFICIAL dataset status, valid_to IS NULL, same anchor ID.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Transition to an UNVERIFIED candidate version as canonical current is rejected
acceptance_matrix.enforcement_mechanism: fn_transition_mandal_current_version() evaluates v_dataset_status and raises ERR-W014-003 if not 'OFFICIAL'.
acceptance_matrix.test_design: Call fn_transition_mandal_current_version() pointing to a candidate version from an UNVERIFIED dataset.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Privilege boundary enforced via PostgreSQL EXECUTE ACLs: PUBLIC ACL verified via catalog inspection, session roles tested at runtime, definer least-privilege & zero unintended privileges verified, and base-table DML inspected across all 4 classes; zero CURRENT_USER/SESSION_USER authorization dependence
acceptance_matrix.enforcement_mechanism: Declarative PostgreSQL ACLs (REVOKE FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated; GRANT TO service_role, panin_boundary_admin); dedicated NOLOGIN owner with exact minimum table grants; zero procedural role checks; direct DML restricted for boundary admin; service_role direct DML classified as infrastructure exception.
acceptance_matrix.test_design: 1. PUBLIC ACL inspection: Query aclexplode(proacl) on fn_transition_mandal_current_version or assert NOT has_function_privilege('public', 'public.fn_transition_mandal_current_version(text,uuid,date,text,uuid)', 'EXECUTE'). (Do NOT attempt runtime execution as PUBLIC; PUBLIC is an ACL principal, not a session role). 2. Runtime session role tests: (a) SET ROLE anon -> call transition function -> 42501. (b) SET ROLE authenticated -> call transition function -> 42501. (c) SET ROLE panin_boundary_admin -> call transition function with valid params -> SUCCESS ('TRANSITION_COMPLETE'); attempt direct INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on mandals or mandal_versions -> 42501. (d) SET ROLE service_role -> call transition function -> SUCCESS; inspect base-table DML (broad DML classified as trusted infrastructure/backend exception, constrained by Layers 1-5 engine integrity triggers). 3. Definer least-privilege catalog inspection: (a) Verify pg_proc: prosecdef=true, proowner='panin_boundary_definer'::regrole. (b) Verify pg_roles: rolcanlogin=false, rolsuper=false, rolcreatedb=false, rolcreaterole=false. (c) Verify pg_auth_members: zero inherited role memberships for panin_boundary_definer. (d) Verify table privileges: has_table_privilege('panin_boundary_definer', tbl, priv) is true ONLY for designed grants (SELECT on dataset_versions, provenance_records; SELECT, UPDATE on mandals, mandal_versions). Assert INSERT, DELETE, TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, TRIGGER all return false across all 4 tables. (e) Verify table ownership: is_table_owner=false across all tables. 4. Inspect function source: Assert zero CURRENT_USER or SESSION_USER authorization branches.
acceptance_matrix.expected_sqlstate_or_error: ACL: PUBLIC has no EXECUTE; Runtime: 42501 for unprivileged session roles, SUCCESS for authorized roles, 42501 for admin direct DML; Definer: exact minimum privileges verified, zero unintended privileges, zero inherited roles.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: p_operator carries ZERO authorization power (audit metadata only)
acceptance_matrix.enforcement_mechanism: Caller authorization is governed strictly by PostgreSQL EXECUTE privileges prior to function entry; p_operator value never inspected for authorization.
acceptance_matrix.test_design: Execute 3-case matrix: (1) unauth caller + p_operator='admin' -> 42501; (2) auth caller + p_operator='random' -> SUCCESS; (3) auth caller + p_operator='admin' -> SUCCESS (authorized purely by caller role, never because p_operator says admin).
acceptance_matrix.expected_sqlstate_or_error: 42501 for Case 1; SUCCESS for Cases 2 and 3

acceptance_matrix.enforcement_mechanism: If p_provenance_id provided, foreign key existence in provenance_records is validated; primary evidence validation is delegated to W012 dataset promotion.
acceptance_matrix.test_design: Call transition function with non-existent p_provenance_id; observe foreign key existence failure.
